Subject: POC hands-on: rollcall + workshop time windows

Hi Ellie / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the productive discovery yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to lock a 2.5-hour hands-on session for the POC where we:
- run an end-to-end prompt review and routing walkthrough,
- exercise routing fallbacks and quantized model variants,
- run a short load test (sustained 5–10 minute spike) to validate concurrency and KV cache behavior, and
- agree on success criteria / acceptance checks.

Proposed structure (high level):
1) 15m roll call + goals and success criteria (exec + devs)
2) 60m prompt review + routing demos (SE-led)
3) 40m guided hands-on exercises (customer-led with SE support)
4) 30m load test & observations, next steps

We can run this in a single 2.5-hour block or split into a 90m prompt workshop + 60m load-run on a separate day if that suits your stakeholders.

Could you share 3 windows (dates + times, PST) next week that work for: Ellie (initiation exec), Rajiv (platform lead), and your infra/IT presence for the load test? We need at least one slot with a member of BrightLayer IT to validate access and firewall rules before the load run.

I've attached a draft agenda and a quick CSV with sample prompts so you can flag any data-sensitivity items.

Thanks —
Nikhil
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Thanks — I reviewed the sample prompts. I marked three entries in the CSV that should be pseudonymized and added comments for the product owner to confirm.

Runbook notes for routing/demo:
- We'll demo two routing policies: latency-tier (low-latency model for short queries) and cost-tier (quantized variant for bulk processing).
- For the workshop, I recommend enabling prefix KV caching for prompt variants so the hands-on exercises complete faster for participants.
- For the load run: target 60 concurrent short requests for a 10-minute sustained window (burst to 200 for 60s) to observe autoscaling behavior. Vivek — will Redwood provide a DHCP-reserved egress IP for the test, or should we provide a list of expected IPs?

I'll update the agenda PDF with these bullets and attach the updated file.

Marissa Cole
